title: U3's census observes a real merge instead of comparing two hand-written lists
context: Plan Task 3 step 5 specified the census as a comparison of Object.keys(THREAD_RULES) against a hand-written mergedThreadFieldPaths() literal, both in the same file, with the test never calling mergeThread. Two reviewers independently demonstrated by running it that a field declared in the rule table, echoed into the helper list, and wired nowhere in the merged object literal passes at exit 0. That is the exact bug shape U3 exists to close, reproduced one level up, and it made the first commit's subject claim false. The census also filtered out all eight spine paths and asserted in one direction only, so it was not the set equality invariant I6 names.
options: Ship the census as the plan specified it, and file the gap for a later unit
Rewrite the census to merge a fully-populated thread and census the paths the merge observably emits, in both directions
Delete the helper and census the merge output alone
outcome: Rewrote the census as a test-only change in the one file U3 owns: merge a fully-populated thread, then census the paths the merge actually emits, in both directions, including the eight spine paths the original filtered out. Kept the exported mergedThreadFieldPaths() helper because the plan declares it as U3's produced interface for later units, and added a third census pinning the helper to that same observation so it cannot drift into a claim the merge does not honour. Verified by mutation: declaring a rule, echoing it into the helper, and wiring it nowhere turns the new census red at exit 1.
